beginner.title: Get started with Wordtune
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Wordtune, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Draft and organise
beginner.outcome: You can: draft efficiently in Wordtune

beginner.title: Edit for clarity
beginner.outcome: You can: improve clarity and correctness
beginner.practice: Edit your draft using Wordtune's suggestions critically

intermediate.title: Long-form and formatting
intermediate.practice: Format a long document for publication

intermediate.title: Style and voice
intermediate.outcome: You can: keep a consistent voice

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Wordtune
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Wordtune distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Wordtune
expert.outcome: You can: use Wordtune's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Publish and collaborate
expert.outcome: You can: publish and work with editors
expert.practice: Publish a piece with an editor's review

expert.title: Integrate Wordtune into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Wordtune with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Wordtune to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Wordtune well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Wordtune" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
